verdict.rationale: Calendly's first-party Workflows feature automates pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts, and teammates, which covers reminder and follow-up sequences over email and SMS around bookings. The evidence is a single marketing-level statement. Missing for 10: detailed docs on sequence timing and triggers (e.g. per-booking reminder offsets), evidence of no-show reduction, independent or hands-on corroboration.
